research.title: Dimensional’s David Booth on How to Interpret Risk and 'Stay Calm' Amid Uncertainty
research.summary: David Booth, the founder and chairman of Dimensional Fund Advisors, uses academic research and market evidence to manage more than $1 trillion in assets. Booth, the author of Stay Calm, joins Raj Mahajan, a senior partner in Goldman Sachs Global Banking & Markets, to discuss how to interpret risk and uncertainty, how outsiders can participate in the market as effectively as insiders, and the long-term magic of compounding.

research.title: Sponsors, spreads and stress testing: Navigating 2026’s rate reset
research.summary: In volatile markets, trade-offs sharpen: pay for certainty now, or preserve flexibility for later. In this episode of Making Sense, Ben Berkey from the corporate derivatives franchise talks with Brian Tramontozzi, head of North American Leveraged Finance Capital Markets, and Kim Hernas, global head of Sponsor Private Side Sales, to discuss how leveraged finance and private markets are weighing these trade-offs in a higher-for-longer rate environment. They discuss how higher base yields are affecting leveraged loan and high-yield markets, and what spread behavior across rating tiers may be signaling. They also explore the evolving sponsor toolkit — back leverage and beyond — and how sponsors are reassessing holding periods, liquidity needs and risk management.
